aiMetadata.description: Imports an external recording into tl;dv by ingesting it from a publicly accessible media URL (.mp3/.mp4/.wav/.m4a/.mkv/.mov/.avi/.wma/.flac), queuing it for transcription and processing. Use to bring a recording hosted elsewhere into tl;dv. Each call creates a new import job (not idempotent); set dryRun to validate the import without persisting it.

query.description: Search for meetings by name or content

to.description: Search meetings up to this date

onlyParticipated.description: Only return meetings you participated in

aiMetadata.description: Lists meetings from the tl;dv account, paginated. With an empty search query it returns all meetings; supplying a query filters to matches by name or content, and optional date range, participation, and internal/external type filters further narrow results. Use to discover meetings or find a meeting id to feed into other actions. Read-only and idempotent.

meeting_ready.name: meeting_ready

webhookInstructions.description:
## Setup Instructions

To use this trigger, configure a webhook in tl;dv:

1. Go to your tl;dv dashboard
2. Navigate to Settings > Webhooks
3. Add a new webhook
4. Set the **URL** to:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
5. Select the **MeetingReady** event type
6. Choose the scope (User, Team, or Organization level)
7. Save the webhook

The webhook will trigger whenever a meeting finishes processing.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a tl;dv meeting has finished processing and is ready, delivering the meeting metadata (id, name, date, duration, organizer, invitees, URL) via a webhook the user configures in tl;dv for the MeetingReady event.

nl.\n## Setup Instructions\n\nTo use this t:
## Setup instructies

Om deze trigger te gebruiken, configureer een webhook in tl;dv:

1. Ga naar uw tl;dv dashboard
2. Navigeer naar Instellingen > Webhooks
3. Voeg een nieuwe webhook toe
4. Zet de **URL** naar:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
5. Selecteer het **MeetingReady** event type
6. Kies het bereik (Gebruiker, Team of Organisatie level)
7. Sla de webhook

De webhook wordt geactiveerd wanneer een vergadering klaar is.

## Setup instructies

2. Navigeer naar Instellingen > Webhooks
3. Voeg een nieuwe webhook toe

```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
5. Selecteer het **TranscriptReady** gebeurtenistype
6. Kies het bereik (Gebruiker, Team of Organisatie level)
7. Sla de webhook

De webhook wordt geactiveerd wanneer een vergadertranscript wordt gegenereerd.

## Einrichtungsanweisungen

Um diesen Trigger zu verwenden, konfigurieren Sie einen Webhook in tl;dv:

1. Gehen Sie zu Ihrem tl;dv-Dashboard
2. Navigieren Sie zu Einstellungen > Webhooks
3. Fügen Sie einen neuen Webhook
hinzu. Setze die **URL** auf:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
5. Wählen Sie das **MeetingReady** Event Typ
6. Wählen Sie den Bereich (Benutzer, Team oder Organisationsebene)
7. Speichern Sie den Webhook

Der Webhook wird ausgelöst, wenn ein Meeting die Verarbeitung beendet.

## Instructions d'installation

Pour utiliser ce déclencheur, configurez un webhook dans tl;dv:

1. Allez sur votre tableau de bord tl;dv
2. Allez dans Paramètres > Webhooks
3. Ajoutez un nouveau webhook
4. Définit **URL** à :
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
5. Sélectionnez le type d'événement **MeetingReady**
6. Choisissez la portée (User, Team, or Organization level)
7. Enregistrer le webhook

Le webhook se déclenchera à chaque fois qu'une réunion se termine le traitement.
